pages.title: Stem Cell Culture
pages.text: A flask of cells that have not yet decided what to become. Any of them could be a neuron, a muscle, a bone. The broth is warm and cloudy and seems to be thinking about its options. Under the microscope they look identical, and that sameness is exactly the point: every possibility is still open.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Synthetic biology lets me write life rather than read it. I took a genome sample, spliced in recombinant DNA to undo specialisation and used an engineered enzyme to hold the cells in their undecided state.
